newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 falls as floods hit shares.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 falls as floods hit shares.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index fell on Friday led by moderate losses to most major issues and a heavy fall from the largest Czech insurance company Ceska Pojistovna.
Pojistovna, which faces huge claims in the wake of flooding affecting almost one third of the country, fell 134 crowns, or the maximum daily allowable 5.0 percent, to 2,556.
"Everyone expected Pojistovna would weaken after the floods ...but there should not be dramatic sell offs," said Petr Opocensky of Citicorp Securities.
Bearish sentiment because of the flooding also affected the most highly capitalised shares.
"Telecom also fell on the reports of the (flood related) damage to the network," Opocensky said.
Construction companies on the other hand posted solid gains with dealers citing the likelehood of windfall orders in the wake of the flooding.
"We are expecting construction companies to outperform the market," said Eugene De Klerk of ABN AMRO Hoare Govett.
Metrostav, the biggest construction sector gainer, rose 70 crowns to 2,200.
